_readme: Industrial company head office, two floors, two finish options, Delhi. Source deck exports are NOT committed (public repo).
Sources are the bitmaps embedded in the October options deck (1672 px renders, 3100 px plans), extracted as-is: they carry no slide labels, callouts or footer, so no crop is needed for those.

Client marks: the client's name in large lettering and a company-history timeline on the reception wall in both reception views (p01, p06, p15), and the name on the MD room panel in both options (p10, p19). All five are excluded, not retouched: the timeline dates and product milestones identify the company even with the name removed. Every artwork, screen and the mandir lettering in the kept views was checked at full size and carries no mark.

The September deck (same client) is not used: its seat counts differ from this deck, and its facade views are photomontages of the real building showing the client's and two neighbouring businesses' signage. The facade options are described in text only.
Not used for space: option 02 plans (p13, p14, same layout as option 01), option 01 L-shaped workpoint (p08), option 02 private cabin (p18), washroom (p22).
